content:
nina-peopleops: Hey all  quick Q thread about manager-of-managers promotions, skip-level recommendations, and how comp/benefits scale for people managers. Drop edge cases.

alec-dir: If an EM gets promoted to Senior EM (manager-of-managers), do we need a separate leadership packet or same promo packet with extra evidence?

nina-peopleops: Use the standard promo packet but add a Leadership Appendix: org scope, number of direct reports, budget ownership, strategic initiatives, and 2 cross-functional sponsor emails. We flag senior leadership candidates for a separate calibration lane.

sam-engmgr: For skip-level nominations (peer or IC nominates their manager for promo), what's required? Can skip-level feedback substitute manager endorsement?

nina-peopleops: Skip-level nominations accepted but manager endorsement still required. Use skip-level feedback as supporting evidence; include at least 3 corroborating statements and product/exec impact. Packets without manager sign-off are treated as nominations and routed to director for follow-up.

zoe-ic: Does a manager promo automatically change benefits (e.g., manager health stipend or parental leave top-up)?

nina-peopleops: Promotions alone don't auto-add benefits unless policy states a specific manager benefit tier. If role change includes a change in benefit eligibility (e.g., managerial parental leave top-up), People Ops will note it in the packet and payroll will enact changes on effective date. Check Benefits matrix: https://confluence.redwood/people/benefits-matrix.

comp-bot: Reminder: Any proposed base increase >20% or new OTE > band_max triggers Comp Committee review. See comp thresholds doc.

alec-dir: How do we handle promotion + relocation at the same time (promo from IC->EM and move countries)? Which effective date and comp currency do we use?

nina-peopleops: Two-step: 1) Level/role decision (internal band), 2) map to local comp band and currency for payroll. Effective date typically aligned to relocation start date but must respect local payroll cutoffs. Include local payroll ticket and FX note. If relocation affects benefits, benefits team must sign off.

sam-engmgr: If a manager role includes budget approval limits, do we capture that in the packet as an operational authority artifact?

nina-peopleops: Yes. Capture approvals matrix snippet in appendix (budget threshold, hiring approvals, vendor sign-off). This helps Compensation and Legal when assessing seniority.

zoe-ic: When a manager is promoted but retains former direct reports (no org move), do we do headcount changes?

nina-peopleops: If the promotion doesn't change headcount or reporting lines, just submit promo packet. If it creates a new manager headcount, request headcount/req change in Workday and attach approval.

alec-dir: Can compensation be split between base and one-time bonus to stay within band? Any rules?

nina-peopleops: You can recommend a split but be transparent. If splitting is used to keep base within band_max while compensating total cash, note it in packet. Comp Committee reviews such constructs for fairness. Bonuses should be time-limited and documented.

comp-bot: FYI: Any split that results in cumulative >15% annualized increase routes to Comp Committee.

sam-engmgr: What about manager promotions that include stock option re-pricing or topping up? Is there a special approvals flow?

nina-peopleops: Equity refresh recommendations must include prior grant history, rationale, vesting schedule, and dilution impact. Off-cycle grants need Head of People + Head of Finance sign-off. Use equity template: https://confluence.redwood/people/equity-refresh-template.

zoe-ic: Edge case: temporary acting manager who covers role for 6 months then reverts. Do we title them acting manager in Workday and do they get comp uplift?

nina-peopleops: Acting assignments use the Acting Manager form. Short-term acting (<90 days) usually gets a stipend, not full promo. Acting >90 days considered for temporary elevation with manager + director + People Ops review. Document expected duration in packet.

alec-dir: If a manager is promoted mid-cycle and payroll misses cutoff, do we auto-retro?

nina-peopleops: If approval is after payroll cutoff, effective date moves to first of next month by default. Finance can approve retro exceptions for critical cases but requires explicit Finance sign-off.

hr-bot: Reminder: Manager promo window closes 2026-05-01 for Q2 calibration exports. Submit by 2026-04-26 to ensure inclusion.

sam-engmgr: One last Q: if a promoted manager negotiates for different reporting lines after promotion (requests to keep some ICs), do we allow partial transfer?

nina-peopleops: Yes, partial transfers are allowed but must be reflected in the packet and Workday headcount actions. Include manager transition plan and timeline. If it affects budget distribution, include finance acknowledgment.

zoe-ic: Thanks everyone  this is helpful. Posting a checklist in my 1:1 notes.

nina-peopleops: I'll update the manager guide and drop the Leadership Appendix template in Confluence. Ping me if you want packet review.
